code:
Infrastructure never stands still:
  server decommissioned  -> operational_status unchanged?
  app upgraded            -> version field unchanged?
  database migrated       -> location field unchanged?

No one drives the update = the CMDB goes stale.
caption: A CMDB isn't a one-time inventory — it has to keep moving to stay accurate.

code:
Same CI, same field, four sources:
  Manual entry      -> "Data Center A"
  Discovery scan     -> "Data Center B"  (actual IP range)
  Data import         -> "Data Center A"  (stale export)
  Integration          -> "Data Center C"  (vendor system)

None of them are lying. They genuinely disagree.
caption: Resolving this is exactly what Chapter 5's Reconciliation rules are for.
